description:
Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown
Project: Diwali Nite Celebration**
Date: 1st November 2026
Venue: Sindhi Gymkhana, Chembur

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown celebrated Diwali Nite with great enthusiasm, festive spirit and fellowship.

The evening was filled with wonderful music and guitar performances by our talented Rotaractors, exciting games, foot-tapping dance, sumptuous food and lovely gifts for everyone.

The celebration was beautifully organised and witnessed enthusiastic participation, bringing members and families together for an evening of joy, laughter and memorable moments.

A wonderful celebration of togetherness, friendship and the true spirit of Rotary!
